title: Cosmic Crystal Oracle
description: A mystical purple-skinned female figure with a single large yellow eye and flowing purple hair stands inside a large transparent crystal sphere. She wears a dark robe with gold trim and green patterns, gesturing with her hands toward a smaller crystal ball on a stand that contains three silhouetted figures under a full moon. The scene is set against a starry night sky with purple nebulae, spotlights, lotus flowers, and a reflective surface below mirroring the entire composition.
prompt: A mystical one-eyed female figure with purple skin and flowing glowing purple hair stands inside a large transparent orb, wearing a dark robe with gold trim. She gestures toward a smaller crystal ball on a stand showing three silhouetted figures under a full moon. Surrounded by floating lotus flowers, butterflies, and a starry cosmic background with purple nebulae and spotlights, with the entire scene reflected on a dark glossy surface below.
